weekFrame.title: This week in DC
weekFrame.support: Twelve shows worth leaving the house for.

notes: Pins from LOI-585 featured-set. curatorNote values are CMO+Board approved Home blurbs (LOI-611 / LOI-656) with no catalog parentheticals. Catalog venue/title/date mismatches remain in match only. Catalog gaps: Shaolin Jazz, Neon Habits, Flashband editorial events. Tiffany Day pin is Atlantis catalog row (blurb still says 9:30 per approved copy). Arlo Parks catalog date Aug 30 (curator listed Sat Aug 29).
